name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: Explains why a view has no content or failed to load, and offers the action that changes that.

when: A list or view has nothing to show yet, no results, or failed to load (tone="danger").

instead.when: Content is present and a message about it is needed.

guidance.rule: Never blame the user; say what will appear and how to get it.

builtIn: With announce, the message (title, description, details) is an alert; the actions stay outside it.
youProvide: A heading level when the state is the page's main content.
For a failed load, a retry Button that shows its pending state (see the example).
